data.title: Enablence Technologies Announces Conference Call to Discuss First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results
data.description:
Management will host a live conference call on Tuesday, November 24, 2026 to discuss financial results and guidance.

Ottawa, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 18, 2026) - Enablence Technologies Inc. ("Enablence" or the "Company"), a leading supplier of planar lightwave circuit (PLC) optical chips for datacom, telecommunications, artificial intelligence (AI), and advanced vision applications, today announced it will host a conference call and release financial results for its first quarter of fiscal 2027 ended September 30, 2026, after the market closes on Tuesday, November 24, 2026.

Management will host a live conference call that day at 2:00 pm PT / 5:00 pm ET to discuss the company's results and guidance.

A live webcast of the conference call can be accessed from the company's investor relations website at https://www.enablence.com/investors. Following the call, a replay of the webcast will also be available on the investor relations website.

About Enablence Technologies Inc.

Enablence is a publicly traded company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange that designs, markets and sells optical chips and sub systems, primarily in the form of planar lightwave circuits (PLC), on silicon-based chips for datacom, telecom, automotive and artificial intelligence (AI) applications. Enablence products serve a global customer base, primarily focused today on data center and other rapidly growing end markets. Enablence also works with customers that have emerging market uses for its technology, including medical devices, automotive LiDAR, and virtual and augmented reality headsets. In select strategic circumstances, the Company also uses its proprietary, non-captive fabrication plant in Fremont, California to manufacture chips designed by third party customers. For more information, visit: www.enablence.com.

data.title: Elon Musk Says Nvidia Ousting Jensen Huang Is Like Kicking Michael Jordan Off A Winning Team
data.description:
Key points:
  • When asked if he sees Huang returning to Nvidia, Musk said that it is ultimately on Nvidia’s board of directors or shareholders.
  • “…there's no one that can really replace Jensen,” Musk said.
  • Musk’s companies and Nvidia share deep business ties.

Tesla Inc. CEO Elon Musk on Wednesday criticized Nvidia’s board’s decision to oust Jensen Huang as CEO, calling it “like kicking Michael Jordan off of your team when you are on a winning streak .”

“I don’t think he’s disloyal to the United States,” Musk said about the former Nvidia CEO who was ousted after reports of romantic relations with a Chinese intelligence asset.

Musk described Huang as “an old friend of mine” and added that the board’s decision to oust him “doesn't seem like a smart decision to me.”

“…there's no one that can really replace Jensen,” Musk said at The New York Times Dealbook Summit. “He has long-term relationships that have been built up over decades. He understands technology incredibly well. His team loves him, loves him, and many of them are there because of him, and have had higher offers to go elsewhere, and have turned them down because of personal loyalty to Jensen.”

Will Huang Return To Nvidia?

When asked if he sees Huang returning to Nvidia, Musk said that it is ultimately on Nvidia’s board of directors or shareholders. “I think, like the current board would either need to change their mind, or shareholders would need to vote the board out at the shareholders meeting, which is that's that's pretty rare for that to happen. So, but really the board is in charge of the company right now,” the Tesla CEO said.

Earlier this week, Nvidia's board chairman firmly stated during the earnings call that Jensen Huang will not be reinstated under any circumstances. Earlier today, it was also reported that a recruitment agency hired by Nvidia’s (NVDA) board has reportedly officially reached out to Arm Holdings (ARM) CEO Rene Haas to take over the reins at the chipmaker.

Musk Companies And Nvidia 

Musk’s companies and Nvidia share deep business ties. SpaceX has publicly committed to building its expanding AI infrastructure, including terrestrial data centers and planned orbital computing, exclusively on Nvidia’s platforms, with Musk describing the Vera Rubin architecture as the best available and stating that the company expects to receive a significant share of Nvidia’s GPU output. Nvidia also holds a stake in SpaceX.

Musk’s EV company Tesla, meanwhile, relies on Nvidia hardware for AI training even as it develops its own inference chips for Full Self-Driving and the Optimus robot.

Talking about his own comments about wanting to hire Huang at the Summit, Musk asked, “Who wouldn't want to hire Jensen?”

How Did TSLA, SPCX Retail Traders React?

On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around TSLA and SPCX was within the 'bullish' territory at the time of writing.

While TSLA stock has slipped 15% year-to-date, SPCX stock is currently trading at about $143.5, above its June IPO price of $135. Nvidia, meanwhile, clocked its fifth consecutive day in the red on Wednesday and is down 19% this year.

data.title: Immutep Reports Encouraging Disease-Free Survival from EFTISARC-NEO Phase II Trial in Soft Tissue Sarcoma
data.description:
Key points:
  • Poster presented today at CTOS 2026 expands on the survival data first reported in the abstract (announced 11 November 2026), which showed a 12-month disease-free survival (DFS) of 81.1% in patients with resectable soft tissue sarcoma.
  • Patients with post-treatment tumour-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) levels above 310 cells/mm² had 95.0% 12-month DFS compared with 64.9% in patients with lower TIL levels.
  • Patients with treatment-related hyalinisation and fibrosis greater than 52% had 93.8% 12-month DFS compared with 71.4% in patients with lower levels.
  • Results build on previously reported strong pathological responses and further support the potential of efti-based combination therapy.

SYDNEY, AUSTRALIA, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Immutep Limited (ASX: IMM; NASDAQ: IMMP) (“Immutep” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing novel LAG-3 immunotherapies for cancer and autoimmune diseases, today announced new data from the investigator-initiated EFTISARC-NEO Phase II study presented at the Connective Tissue Oncology Society (CTOS) 2026 Annual Meeting (Poster number P 448).

The study is evaluating Immutep’s eftilagimod alfa (efti) in combination with KEYTRUDA® (pembrolizumab) and radiotherapy before surgery in patients with high-risk, resectable soft tissue sarcoma. Forty patients were enrolled, and 38 patients underwent surgery and were included in the survival evaluation.

The latest analysis currently shows a disease-free survival (DFS) of 81.1% at 12 months. The current Kaplan-Meier estimate at 18 months is also 81.1%, although this later time point remains immature, and follow-up is ongoing. Among the 38 patients who underwent surgery and were evaluated, eight patients had experienced disease recurrence at the data cut-off (April 30, 2026).

Table 1 – Survival results for soft tissue sarcoma patients from EFTISARC-NEO

OutcomeLatest Analysis
12-month disease-free survival (mature)81.1%
18-month disease-free survival (immature)81.1%
12-month local recurrence-free survival94.1%
12-month distant metastasis-free survival86.2%
Median follow-up19.1 months

In addition, exploratory analyses showed that higher levels of tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) and greater hyalinisation and fibrosis after treatment may be associated with better DFS. In particular, patients with post-treatment TIL levels above 310 cells/mm² had 95.0% 12-month DFS compared with 64.9% in patients with lower TIL levels. Patients with treatment-related hyalinisation and fibrosis greater than 52% had 93.8% 12-month DFS compared with 71.4% in patients with lower levels of hyalinisation and fibrosis. The presence of tertiary lymphoid structures (TLS) and baseline expression of PD-L1, LAG-3 and TIGIT did not correlate with survival outcomes.

These survival and exploratory findings build on previously reported EFTISARC-NEO results in which the trial met its primary endpoint with a median tumour hyalinisation/fibrosis of 51.5% following neoadjuvant therapy with efti, pembrolizumab and radiotherapy. The new data are consistent with efti's mechanism of action, in which activation of antigen-presenting cells drives a stronger anti-tumour T cell response, and suggest that a stronger immune response in the tumour may be associated with improved patient survival outcomes.

Pawel Sobczuk, MD PhD, one of the Principal Investigators of EFTISARC-NEO, said: “These results are highly encouraging for patients with high-risk soft tissue sarcoma, where recurrence remains a major concern despite surgery and radiotherapy. Disease-free survival of approximately 81% maintained through 12 months and on a preliminary basis also at 18 months is an important observation, and the association between a strong immune response in the tumour and better disease-free survival is particularly compelling. Together with the substantial pathological responses previously reported, the findings reinforce the potential of this novel neoadjuvant approach and provide a strong rationale for continued follow-up and further clinical evaluation.”

Marc Voigt, CEO of Immutep, said: “With the data to date, EFTISARC-NEO is delivering an increasingly coherent and encouraging picture. The marked difference in outcomes between patients with higher and lower post-treatment immune cell infiltration is especially notable and is consistent with efti’s potential to help generate a stronger anti-tumour immune response. We believe these results strengthen the rationale for further potential clinical development in this indication, where patients remain in need of more effective treatment options.”

The poster is available on the Posters & Publications page of Immutep’s website.

Next Steps

Immutep anticipates reporting additional data from EFTISARC-NEO in CY2027.

Subject to regulatory interactions, manufacturing timelines, partnering arrangements and available resources, the Company is preparing to advance efti into a registration-directed clinical trial in neoadjuvant soft tissue sarcoma, targeting initiation in H2 CY2027.

About EFTISARC-NEO

EFTISARC-NEO is an investigator-initiated, open-label Phase II trial evaluating eftilagimod alfa (efti) in combination with KEYTRUDA® (pembrolizumab) and radiotherapy as neoadjuvant treatment for patients with resectable soft tissue sarcoma. The trial is led by the Maria Skłodowska-Curie National Research Institute of Oncology in Warsaw, Poland, and is primarily funded by a grant from the Polish Medical Research Agency, with Immutep supplying efti.

The primary endpoint is pathological response, measured as the percentage of tumour hyalinisation/fibrosis at resection. Secondary endpoints include safety, disease-free survival, local recurrence-free survival, distant metastasis-free survival, overall survival, radiological response and health-related quality of life. Forty patients were enrolled, with enrolment completed in January 2025 (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT06128863).

About Eftilagimod Alfa (efti)

Eftilagimod alfa (efti) is Immutep’s proprietary soluble LAG-3 protein and MHC Class II agonist that activates antigen-presenting cells through the MHC Class II pathway, engaging both innate and adaptive immunity, including the priming of cytotoxic CD8+ T cells and the production of co-stimulatory signals and cytokines. Its favourable safety profile enables combination with anti-PD-(L)1 therapy, radiotherapy and/or chemotherapy. Efti has received Fast Track designation from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration in first-line head and neck squamous cell carcinoma and first-line non-small cell lung cancer, and Orphan Drug Designation in soft tissue sarcoma.

About Immutep

Immutep is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing novel immunotherapies for cancer and autoimmune disease. The Company is a pioneer in the understanding and advancement of therapeutics related to Lymphocyte Activation Gene-3 (LAG-3), and its diversified product portfolio harnesses LAG-3’s ability to stimulate or suppress the immune response. Immutep is dedicated to leveraging its expertise to bring innovative treatment options to patients in need and to maximise value for shareholders. For more information, please visit www.immutep.com.

Forward-Looking Statements

This press release contains forward-looking statements, including statements regarding anticipated clinical development, regulatory progress and potential benefits of eftilagimod alfa. These forward-looking statements are based on current expectations, estimates and projections, and involve known and unknown risks, uncertainties and other important factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from those expressed or implied in such statements.

Factors that could cause actual results to differ materially include risks associated with clinical trial outcomes, regulatory developments, and the Company’s ability to advance its product candidates.

data.title: Anthropic Officially Prices Its IPO At $83 A Share In $81.3B Debut, Shattering IPO Records
data.description:
Key points:
  • Anthropic and its seven co-founders raised $81.3 billion across 980 million shares, surpassing SpaceX’s previous all-time IPO record.
  • Orders for the offering outpaced available shares by nearly seven times despite a broader tech market downturn.
  • The Claude developer is set to debut on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker ‘ANT’.

Artificial intelligence developer Anthropic priced its initial public offering at $83 per share Wednesday evening, in the largest public market debut in history with a valuation of roughly $1.5 trillion.

Anthropic and its seven co-founders raised a combined $81.3 billion through the upsized sale of 980 million shares of Class A common stock compared to the previously marketed range of $70 to $78 per share.

The offering, which includes a $26 billion private placement, eclipsed the previous global IPO record set by SpaceX. Including its over-allotment option, SpaceX had raised $86.2 billion.

Structure of the Offering

Anthropic directly sold 956.35 million shares, while certain selling stockholders—specifically the company's co-founders—offloaded 23.65 million shares. Anthropic stated it will not collect any financial proceeds from the shares sold by its co-founders.

Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC and Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC spearheaded the underwriting syndicate alongside 20 additional financial institutions. Shares are scheduled to begin trading Thursday on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol ‘ANT’.

Heavy Demand Defies Tech Slump

Orders for Anthropic’s shares reached nearly seven times the available supply, drawing heavy interest from global financial hubs including New York, London and Tokyo.

Because demand far exceeded supply, bankers notified prospective buyers that existing backers would receive priority allocations, leaving some new investors with smaller stakes than requested, Bloomberg reported.

The robust appetite materialized despite broader headwinds in the technology sector. The Nasdaq 100 Index fell 4.4% over the week leading up to Wednesday's market close, while chipmaker Nvidia Corp. saw its stock decline 2.9% Wednesday for a fifth consecutive losing session. Notably, Nvidia is set to acquire $10 billion worth of Anthropic stock through the offering's private placement component.

Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) and Amazon (AMZN) share prices also rose after-hours. Both companies own sizable chunks of Anthropic.

Microsoft (MSFT), Salesforce (CRM) and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) are among other large tech companies that have invested in Anthropic.

Where Does Anthropic Stand?

Anthropic has now become the first AI lab to list on a public exchange, beating primary rival OpenAI, which is not expected to pursue a public listing before 2027.

At a $1.5 trillion valuation, Anthropic immediately ranks among the 15 largest publicly traded companies globally, standing roughly on par with Tesla Inc.(TSLA).

Retail sentiment on Stocktwits towards Anthropic was ‘extremely bullish’ ahead of its official pricing, with ‘extremely high’ message volumes.

data.title: Japan Or Machinery Orders Sink 0.3% In September
data.description:
TOKYO (dpa-AFX) - The value of core machinery orders in Japan was down a seasonally adjusted 0.3 percent on month in September, the Cabinet Office said on Thursday - coming in at 1,066.2 billion yen.

That was shy of expectations for an increase of 1.3 percent following the 5.2 percent gain in August.

On a yearly basis, orders rose 13.4 percent - again missing expectations for 13/7 percent and down from 18.6 percent in the previous month.

For the third quarter of 2026, orders were up 1.2 percent on quarter and 14.1 percent on year at 3,152.8 billion yen.

For the fourth quarter of 2026, orders re forecast to rise 4.3 percent on quarter and 13.9 percent on year to 3,287.0 billion yen.

data.title: Australia shares extend losses as miners slide; jobs data in focus
data.description:
Australian shares edged lower on Thursday, on track for a sixth consecutive day of losses as miners extended their slide on persistent weakness in copper prices, while investors awaited domestic employment data due later in the day.

The S&P/ASX 200 index was down 0.9% at 8,821.80 points, as of 2300 GMT. The benchmark closed 0.7% lower on Wednesday.

Miners declined 3.5% to their weakest level since late March as copper prices slumped to a seven-month low.

The sub-index has shed roughly 14% over the past few sessions despite a mild recovery in iron ore futures in the previous session.

Shares of BHP fell 3.8% to an early-April low on Thursday, while Rio Tinto hovered near its weakest level since last December.

Gold stocks shed 3.6% as hawkish signals from the US Federal Reserve pushed gold to a 14-month low, reinforcing expectations that interest rates will remain higher for longer.

Shares of Northern Star Resources and Evolution Mining were down 3% each.

Meanwhile, banks retreated 0.2%, putting the sub-index on track for a third consecutive session of losses.

National Australia Bank and Macquarie fell 0.6% each, outweighing modest gains in the other major lenders.

Australia's October employment data is due at 0030 GMT and will be closely scrutinised for clues on whether labour market conditions remain a source of concern for the Reserve Bank of Australia.

Last month, RBA Governor Michele Bullock said that the labour market continued to be tighter than the central bank had previously assessed and that a further period of economic growth would be needed to bring sticky inflation back under control.

Technology stocks fell 0.3% despite overnight gains on the tech-heavy Nasdaq after chipmaker Nvidia forecast quarterly revenue above estimates.

Shares of Xero fell 0.5%.

Farther south-east, New Zealand's benchmark S&P/NZX 50 index fell 0.2% to 14,264.29 points.

data.title: Tesla Plans Model Y With No Steering Wheel, Musk Says — WSJ
data.description:
By Sean O'Kane

Tesla is working on a version of its top-selling Model Y SUV that will have no steering wheel or pedals, Chief Executive Elon Musk said Wednesday.

Musk, speaking at the New York Times DealBook Summit, said Tesla wants to offer a fully autonomous vehicle for ride-hailing that could fit a "whole family in the car."

"So what we plan to do is have an autonomous version of Model Y that wouldn't have steering wheels and pedals, and would be good for transporting groups of six or seven people," he said.

An autonomous Model Y could ferry more passengers than the Cybercab, which seats two. That vehicle is used in Tesla's Robotaxi service, but the company recently opened orders for private sale as well.

The Model Y is now Tesla's best-selling EV. Musk said Wednesday that the newest variant-the larger Model YL- has become the most popular version. "I think we probably need to change all of the Model Y production to the YL because it's what most people seem to want," he said.

This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).

data.title: Century Complete Celebrates Model Home Grand Opening at Cates Bay Crossing in Conway, South Carolina
data.description:
New community brings 94 homesites to well-connected location 15 miles from Myrtle Beach

  • Floor Plans Designed for Real Life: Cates Bay Crossing offers five one- and two-story floor plans priced from the $260s. Select plans feature versatile living spaces such as flex rooms, gamerooms, and private studies.

CONWAY, S.C., Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Century Communities, Inc. ()—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—will host a model home Grand Opening at Cates Bay Crossing, a Century Complete community in Conway, South Carolina, offering new homes from the $260s.

The event will take place on Saturday, Nov. 21, from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. Visitors can tour the new model home and meet members of The Myrtle Beach Pelicans, the local Minor League Baseball team, who will be in attendance from noon to 2 p.m.

Learn more and RSVP for the Grand Opening at www.CenturyCommunities.com/CatesBaySC.

"Cates Bay Crossing pairs adaptable, attainably priced new homes with a scenic location that's a short drive from schools with easy access to Myrtle Beach," said Regional President Andy Kern. "Prospective homebuyers should attend our Nov. 21 Grand Opening to explore move-in ready options, tour our new model, and find out what makes this the perfect place for their next chapter."

data.title: Copper Lake Announces Grant of Stock Options
data.description:
Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 18, 2026) - Copper Lake Resources Ltd. (FSE: W0I0) ("Copper Lake" or the "Company") announces that its Board of Directors has granted an aggregate of 4,100,000 incentive stock options (the "Options") to directors, officers and consultants of the Company pursuant to the Company's stock option plan.

Each Option entitles the holder to purchase one common share of the Company at an exercise price of $0.25 per share until November 18, 2031. The Options vested immediately upon grant. Of the Options granted, 1,650,000 were granted to directors and officers of the Company and 2,450,000 were granted to consultants of the Company.

The Options, and any common shares issued upon the exercise of the Options prior to March 19, 2027, are subject to a four-month hold period in accordance with the policies of the TSX Venture Exchange. The grant of the Options is subject to the policies of the TSX Venture Exchange.

ABOUT COPPER LAKE RESOURCES

Copper Lake Resources Ltd. is a publicly traded Canadian mineral exploration and development company with interests in two projects both located in Ontario.

The Marshall Lake high-grade VMS copper, zinc, silver and gold project, comprises an area of approximately 220 square km located 120 km north of Geraldton, Ontario and is just 22 km north of the main CNR rail line. Copper Lake has an 82.97% interest in the joint ventured property, which consists of 233 claims and 52 mining leases. The project also includes 148 claim cells staked in 2018 and 2020 that are 100% owned and not subject to any royalties. These newer claims add approximately 30 square km to the property.

In addition to the original Marshall Lake property above, Marshall Lake also includes the Sollas Lake and Summit Lake properties, which are 100% owned by the Company and are not subject to any royalties. The Sollas Lake property consists of 20 claim cells comprising an area of 4 square km on the east side of the Marshall Lake property where historical EM airborne geophysical surveys have outlined strong conductors on the property hosted within the same favorable felsic volcanic units. The Summit Lake property currently consists of 100 claim cells comprising an area of 20.5 square km, is accessible year-round, and is located immediately west of the original Marshall Lake property. The Marshall Lake project is located in the traditional territories of Aroland and Animbiigoo Zaagi'igan Anishinaabek ("AZA") First Nations.

Copper Lake has a 69.79% joint venture interest in the Norton Lake nickel, copper, cobalt, and palladium PGM property, located in the southern Ring of Fire area, is approximately 100 km north of the Marshall Lake Property. The Company filed an updated NI 43-101 in October 2023 with a mineral resource of open pit and underground Measured + Indicated Resources of 1,795,000 tonnes at an average grade of 0.72% NI, 0.69% Cu, 339 ppm Co, 0.52 g/t Pd, 0.17 g/t Pt and containing 28.3Mlbs of nickel and 27.3Mlbs of copper. The Norton Lake property is located in the traditional territories of Eabametoong ("Fort Hope") and Neskantaga First Nations.

data.title: Wall Street Giants Shift From Tech Bets to Balanced Hedging in Third-Quarter 13F Filings
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, citing Shanghai Securities News, third-quarter 13F filings showed major investment firms cutting positions in broad U.S. stock ETFs and reallocating within technology and toward defensive sectors. Bridgewater reduced its holdings in the SPDR S&P 500 ETF and iShares Core S&P 500 ETF by 36% and 50%, respectively, while Renaissance Technologies sold all 219,000 of its SPDR S&P 500 ETF shares. Millennium Management cut its position in that fund from 4.857 million shares to 2.4 million. Barclays reduced its SPDR S&P 500 ETF holdings by 11% and its Nasdaq-100 ETF holdings by 47%; JPMorgan cut its Nasdaq-100 ETF position by 22%.

Renaissance Technologies sharply reduced its holdings in Nvidia, Apple, Amazon and Meta, while increasing its Micron position from 210,000 shares to 1.52 million, AMD from 830,000 to 2 million, and Sandisk from 4,980 to 276,500. Bridgewater also cut its Nvidia, Amazon, Alphabet and Microsoft holdings, while more than doubling its Micron position and increasing its Sandisk stake from 317 shares to 66,800.

Fidelity International increased holdings in AstraZeneca, Agnico Eagle Mines and Bank of Nova Scotia. UBS opened a position of 13.81 million shares in Exxon Mobil and added 610,000 Chevron shares. BlackRock, Vanguard Capital Management and State Street Group also increased their Coca-Cola holdings. As of November 17, AstraZeneca and Coca-Cola had each gained more than 10% since October. Barclays upgraded U.S. health care to “positive” from “neutral” on November 16, citing favorable demand and rising earnings expectations. Standard Chartered recommended diversification across technology, financials, health care and high-dividend stocks in an early-November strategy view.

data.title: Anthropic surpasses SpaceX to become world's biggest IPO, raises $81.3 billion in upsized offering
data.description:
Artificial Intelligence lab Anthropic PBC has raised $81.3 billion in an upsized Initial Public Offering (IPO), making it the biggest in the world, surpassing Elon Musk's SpaceX, which debuted only a few months prior.

In an official release on Thursday, November 19, Anthropic stated that it had upsized the offering, selling 980 million shares, instead of the 825 million planned earlier. The company also priced the IPO at $83 apiece, well above the initial range of $70 to $78 per share.

Earlier this year, Elon Musk's SpaceX had raised $75 billion through its IPO and a total of $85.7 billion, after underwriters exercised their overallotment.

Anthropic's release stated that the underwriters have been given a 30-day option to purchase another 147 million shares. Shares will list on the Nasdaq later this evening.

The company's overall market capitalization will depend on the number of shares outstanding, but the price has already put the valuation past the $1.4 trillion that the company had targeted earlier.

While Anthropic has already raised over $81 billion through its IPO, a group of tech companies, including Google, Microsoft, Nvidia, and AMD, have collectively agreed to invest $26 billion in the company at the IPO price, which will take the total fund raise past $100 billion. Anthropic is a buyer of costly systems from all of these companies.

Anthropic was co-founded in 2021 by Dario Amodei and a group of researchers who had collectively defected from OpenAI, and has now become a competitive force against Sam Altman's company after developing a family of AI models known as Claude.

As per the latest IPO document, each co-founder is selling 3.38 million shares in the Anthropic IPO, for total proceeds of $1.96 billion.

For the nine months that ended on September 30, Anthropic generated $33.24 billion in revenue, up nearly 1,200% from the same period last year. The company reported a net loss of $104 billion for the same period, although most of that was due to change in the fair value of convertible notes and derivative liabilities. For the same nine months in 2025, Anthropic had lost $25.1 billion.

An amended filing also disclosed that its revenue run-rate at the end of October was nearly $81 billion, $10 billion higher than the previous month.

Anthropic's IPO prospectus had over 90 pages of risk factors for investors to consider ahead of the IPO, which included two high-profile disputes with the Trump Administration earlier this year.

“Our aim is to help humankind chart a safe course through this technological evolution, open new frontiers of discovery, and bring forth an age of miracles,” Anthropic’s co-founders wrote in the company’s prospectus. “Everyone who owns our stock, whether an institution or an individual, becomes part of that effort.”

(With Inputs From Agencies)

data.title: Tesla Wins Manitoba Court Order On EV Rebate Ban As Canadian PM Carney Notes Brand’s Fading Cachet
data.description:
Key points:
  • Canadian PM Mark Carney emphasized on Wednesday that Chinese automakers now present the fiercest competition, offering fully electric models packed with advanced AI and high-tech features.
  • Carney also urged the U.S. to act as a more willing partner to Canada and Mexico in the auto sector rather than prolonging a trade war.
  • Last week, a Manitoba court issued an order opening the Canadian province’s decision to block EV rebates for Teslas for cross-examination, Bloomberg reported. 

EV giant Tesla has reportedly obtained a procedural win in its legal challenge to the Canadian province of Manitoba’s decision to bar its vehicles from its electric vehicle rebate program, a dispute rooted in Canada’s broader response to U.S. trade tensions.

Tesla once dominated Canada’s EV market, as noted by Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney at the DealBook Summit earlier on Wednesday. The company continues to sell in the country but has lost significant market share since. Tesla’s Canadian registrations fell more than 60% in 2025, from roughly 55,000 units in 2024 to an estimated 18,300–20,000.

Manitoba Court Requires Decision Record

Manitoba’s program offers rebates of up to C$4,000 ($2,791) on qualifying EVs. In March 2025, amid escalating U.S.-Canada tariff disputes under President Donald Trump, the province excluded Tesla vehicles as well as those manufactured in China from the rebate program. The exclusion was later extended for another year.

A Manitoba court last week ordered the provincial government to produce a complete record of its decision, supported by an affidavit from a knowledgeable official, within 10 days, opening the door to cross-examination, Bloomberg reported.

Tesla’s Past Dominance And Chinese Competition

Speaking at the New York Times DealBook Summit, Carney addressed Canada’s January decision to admit 49,000 Chinese EVs annually at a 6.1% tariff rate, with a firm cap above that volume. He noted that Tesla benefited from the change by shipping vehicles from its Shanghai factory, while it previously shipped vehicles to Canada from its U.S. facilities.

Before 2024, Carney observed, EVs in Canada “were all Teslas.” He acknowledged owning one himself but said he no longer does, adding that resale values have disappointed because the brand no longer holds the same cachet.

“I don’t have it any more, sorry Elon. And I didn’t get the resale value for it that I thought I would because they don’t quite have the cachet that they used to,” Carney said.

Carney emphasized that Chinese automakers now present the fiercest competition, offering fully electric models packed with advanced AI and high-tech features. He argued that North America lags China, as does Europe, and urged the U.S. to act as a more willing partner to Canada and Mexico in the auto sector rather than prolonging a trade war. Trump has signaled plans to raise tariffs on Canadian cars, trucks, and parts to 50% starting January 1, 2027.

Tesla’s key global rival, BYD, is currently seeking to compete with the American EV maker in Canada, as are others including Geely and Chery.

How Did TSLA Retail Traders React?

On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around TSLA stock stayed within ‘bullish’ territory over the past 24 hours, while message volume stayed at 'low' levels.

TSLA stock has dropped 15% year-to-date.
